description.value: Serano Greek Pastry is a neighbourhood bakery on West Broadway in Vancouver specializing in Greek pastries, cakes, and desserts. Customer reviews highlight a warm, friendly atmosphere and a broad selection of traditional Greek baked goods. It would make a pleasant mid-ride sweet stop for cyclists travelling along the Broadway corridor.
